title: Nineteen Minutes
author: Jodi Picoult
summary: In a quiet New Hampshire town, a teenage boy opens fire at his high school, and the story moves between the day itself and the years of bullying, family life and court case around it.
readIf: you want an emotional, issue-driven novel that looks at how a tragedy came about.
skipIf: you find fiction about school violence too upsetting to read.
